start_here: Say to your AI: "Set how people can find me in the Network, with the profile row to keep", with {"subject":"person:sample-bo","database":"sample_for_who_runs_it","offering":"Flour milling and sieves"}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads and writes the network_records rows of the database named, and answers the rows it changed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Set how people can find me in the Network, with the profile row to keep", and give it subject (this person), database (the pursuit database that holds the network_records table), and the fields the ask needs.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, the tool id and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the answer: a profile saved is named by stored; a search names people by handle, never by contact; a contact is answered only while an introduction is released.
